referenceSources.title: 1995 Nissan Skyline GTR LM: What Gearbox Whine?
referenceSources.description:
The 1995 Nissan Skyline GT-R LM, developed by Nismo, is displayed against a white backdrop, highlighting its white and blue livery and sponsor decals such as “Keep The Dream Alive,” Clarion, JOMO, and Bridgestone. Its aerodynamic front end features quad headlights, a pronounced splitter, and multi-spoke racing wheels shod in Bridgestone tires.

This R33-based Group A race car was converted to rear-wheel drive and fitted with a Group N–spec 400-horsepower engine and an Xtrac 6-speed sequential transmission. It competed at the 1995 24 Hours of Le Mans, finishing 10th overall and 5th in class, and is now preserved in Nismo’s Zama Museum, occasionally driven at Fuji Speedway.
